text:
About 86% of the global population aged 15 and over was literate in 2015, per UNESCO Institute for Statistics data, leaving roughly 750 to 780 million adults illiterate. The team note's claim that the rate had fallen to the low eighties and that fewer than one in five adults couldn't read doesn't match that data, which shows literacy rising over time. The exact figure depends on the UNESCO release and methodology.

CONFIDENCE: 80
